en.description:
“Not playing videogames has never been this much fun” - Jim Sterling, GamesRadar (iPhone Game of the Day)
"This game has made me laugh more than any other I've played in recent memory" - GamePro (App Store Games of the Week)
"Ultimately, GodVille is a fun, funny, incredibly clever little game" - Destructoid

Welcome to a self-playing comedy game about gods, heroes, and lack of subordination. Want to be a deity? A hero of yours is totally ready to ignore your wishes.
 
It's a parody take on MMORPG and levelling. Here you can do literally nothing, while your character progresses on his own, writing a story on the go. Or you could show this mortal your will and control him (unsuccessfully). Either way, it'll be lots of fun. And puns. Lots of them.

The game requires persistent internet connection.

PS: If you're having a problem with the game please contact us using Menu-> Feedback within the app or via email support@godvillegame.com
en.releaseNotes:
Contextual help buttons - look for (?) markers in the UI to jump straight to relevant help (can be disabled in Menu->Settings).
This update also includes some internal changes - if something feels off or broken, please report it via Ideabox.

- the town hero is returning to is marked on the map
- other minor changes and improvements
Seven (!) new widgets for peeking at the hero, available for the home screen and widget panel (iOS 17+ required).
minor fixes for VoiceOver

Live Activities and the Lock Screen now show notifications for ongoing adventures (iOS 17.2+ required; if it gets annoying, turn it off in the Settings app - quick link in app's Menu->Settings).
New todo widget with a list of newspaper tasks (coupon, bingo, etc). Also inventory widgets now indicate the presence of activatable trophies by displaying "@".
The sea around the ark in Sail now has a dotted line - it's a visual reminder of health and the maximum distance with your current supplies.

New major goal and feature for seasoned players - Relics!
Also a reworked login screen with a nice game logo.
Font size customization is here: pick from 4 sizes in the app settings.
Adds support for voting on player ideas with a brand new cards system (coming soon).
